title: fix(console): the /data page keeps its list's search, sort, grouping and Filter panel in the address
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9GPJ8pmbK219Pay95x25Uno)_
Fixes #36408
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在对象的「数据」页上，读者的搜索、排序、分组和筛选面板条件，打开一条记录再关闭、或刷新页面之后都还在，地址栏也能直接复制分享。
- 为什么做：列表体验收口——数据页此前每打开一条记录就丢掉读者的搜索，只能重新输入；对象列表早已保留这些，这里补齐同样的做法。
- 出错会怎样：数据页的读者可能看到一个他没想要的搜索或筛选还在生效；页面的「已筛选」标签与「重置」照常可用，合并可直接回滚撤销。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

`ObjectDataPage` (`/apps/APP/OBJECT/data`) now keeps its list's own state in the address, under the keys `ObjectView` already uses and through the same reader and writer (`parseListStateParams` / `applyListStateParams` from `userFilterUrlState.ts`, reused unchanged; `objectViewListUrlState.ts` is not touched):

| What | Param | How the list reads it | How a change is written |
|---|---|---|---|
| search | `uf__search` | `initialSearchTerm` | `onSearchChange`, replace |
| sort | `uf__sort` | `schema.sort` | `onSortChange`, replace; an emptied sort deletes the param (no sort is this page's default) |
| grouping | `uf__group` | `schema.grouping` | `onGroupingChange`, replace |
| Filter panel | `uf__filter` | `initialFilters` | `onFilterChange`, replace |

Opening a record already carried the page's address as the record page's origin (`listOriginOf`), so its close, a reload and a copied link now open the list as the reader left it. `/data` has no pager (measured in #36299's report), so `uf__page` is not wired.

**The design point, as settled in the claim (two layers, no new spelling).** `filter[...]` stays the page's own address conditions: the removable 「Filtered by」 tags, what 「Reset」 puts back to the source, and what "Save as view" saves (unchanged here). `uf__filter` is the Filter panel on top of them, exactly as `ObjectView` keeps its panel on top of the view's filter. `ListView` applies both (the conditions AND the panel); nothing writes one from the other. No case was measured where the two layers conflict: a panel condition on the same field as a `filter[...]` tag simply narrows further (AND), the same as a panel condition over a view filter on the object list.

**Seed.** The state is read from the address once per object and list generation (the `ListView` props it feeds are one-shot), through `ObjectView`'s field gate (a field the object does not declare, or one the reader cannot read once permissions are loaded, is dropped), and a `uf__filter` that loses any condition to the checks is refused whole with `ObjectView`'s notice (`console.objectView.linkFilterRefused`, objectstack#31869's posture). The seed is then written back (replace) so the address shows what the list shows. Unlike `ObjectView` (objectstack#35955), a reload is not a reset here: `/data` has no view to return to and no draft store, and the card's acceptance asks for reload survival.

**`viewDefaults`.** `schema.sort` / `schema.grouping` now carry the address's state, so the page hands `ListView` its own defaults apart (`DATA_PAGE_LIST_DEFAULTS`: no sort, no grouping; hidden fields and row height left unset, which is what the page's schema already had). The list therefore still draws no 「Reset to default」 for a sort nobody declared, and judges a reader-added grouping level as the reader's.

**`resetToSource` (the PM's mechanism assumption, measured).** `resetToSource` and `conditionsAreSourced` match the `uf_` prefix, so the `uf__*` keys are cleared by 「Reset」 and counted by its enabled state, as the claim assumed. That is the wanted behaviour (back to the list as the related list opened it), but clearing the address alone was not enough: `ListView` takes its search and panel once, at mount, so the list kept applying a search the address no longer carried. 「Reset」 now also moves a list generation (`key` on `ListView`), so the list remounts on an empty seed with no search, sort, grouping, panel or quick-filter selection. That seed deliberately writes nothing back: the router commits the reset's navigation in a transition, and a write-back from the render that still read the old location put the removed `filter[status]` back (caught by the Reset pin below before the fix).

**The L567 comment.** Its intent was #2251's "nothing here writes back to any saved view": the schema-level `onSortChange` / `onFilterChange` hooks are the ones `ObjectView`'s relay uses to persist a view. That stays true; the comment now says the list's own changes go to the address only, through `ListView`'s host callbacks.

Files to read first, by risk:

1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectDataPage.tsx` — the seed block (`listSeedRef`, the write-back effect and its reset skip), then `resetToSource`.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectDataPage.tsx` — the `ListView` props (`key`, `viewDefaults`, the four callbacks) and the schema's `sort` / `grouping` rungs.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectDataPage.openRule-35875.test.tsx` — the new top-level `describe`.

## Tests

The pins go into the page's existing open/close harness (`ObjectDataPage.openRule-35875.test.tsx`) as one new top-level `describe`, driven through the real `ObjectDataPage`, `ListView` grid and `MePermissionsProvider`:

- the card's pin: a search typed in the toolbar, the record opened by its name and closed with the page's ✕: the origin carries `uf__search`, the list the close returns to still sends `$search` and shows the term;
- a reload of an address with `filter[status]`, `uf__search`, `uf__sort` and `uf__filter`: the query carries the search, the sort, and both layers' conditions; the address keeps both layers as they came; the panel condition draws no 「Filtered by」 tag; all of it survives an open and close;
- a reload of an address with `uf__group`: the grid asks for its groups by that field, the address keeps it;
- CONTROL: an address without list state sends no search, sort or grouping and gets none written;
- a `uf__filter` naming an undeclared field is refused whole and leaves the address, `filter[...]` untouched;
- 「Reset」 to the source: `uf__search` leaves the address and the list stops searching;
- a sort the reader removes leaves the address, and no 「Reset to default」 is drawn.

No existing test was changed.

- `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectDataPage` (under `os-verify-lock`, after the `origin/main` merge, head `1a95ac7a`): `Test Files 9 passed (9)`, `Tests 96 passed (96)` (89 before this PR, all still green).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The refused-panel notice reuses `ObjectView`'s string, which says the list "shows the view without it"; on `/data` there is no saved view. Not a new key, to keep this PR off the locale packs.
- "Save as view" saves the `filter[...]` conditions only, as ruled; a Filter panel condition, search, sort or grouping on `/data` is not carried into the new view.
- Read from code, not measured: when the route moves from one object's `/data` page straight to another's, the page stays mounted and `ListView` is not remounted (unchanged here: it carries no object key), so its one-shot search and panel are not re-read from the new address; the seed for the new object's sort and grouping is. The quick-filter selections (`uf_FIELD`) were already captured once per page mount the same way. Console navigation reaches `/data` from a list or a related list, which mounts the page afresh.
- Read from code, not measured: the phone list panels emit through the same `ListView` callbacks, so they write the same params.

## Verification

Two minutes: open `/apps/APP/OBJECT/data` in the console, type a term in the list's search, open a record by its name, press ✕ — the list comes back still searching for it, and the address bar shows `uf__search=TERM`; reload — still searching.
